exposure: Reduced numbers of specific regulatory T cell subpopulations (CD4+CD25+FoxP3+, CD4+CD25+FoxP3+CD45RA-, CD4+CD25+FoxP3+Helios+, and CD4+CD25+FoxP3+CD39-) in maternal circulation during the first trimester
cohort: The study enrolled 43 women with early singleton pregnancies, excluding those with autoimmune diseases, diabetes mellitus, primary hypertension, or who had been treated with vaginal progesterone prior to sample collection.
finding: Early first trimester alterations, specifically diminished levels, in specific regulatory T cell subpopulations (CD4+CD25+FoxP3+, CD4+CD25+FoxP3+CD45RA-, CD4+CD25+FoxP3+Helios+, and CD4+CD25+FoxP3+CD39-) were significantly associated with subsequent idiopathic spontaneous preterm labor.
gest_age: Participants experienced preterm labor between 23rd and 33rd weeks of gestation or delivered at term.
